doc: Recorded by `atd record --capability reader.structurizr` from what the desktop host's module shows when parity/scripts/c4/container/courier.json of etalii.adp.ide.desktop opens its document; never edited by hand.

attributes.name: Sender
attributes.description: Books a delivery and follows where the parcel is.

attributes.name: Courier
attributes.description: Collects and delivers parcels, and scans them on the way.

attributes.name: Support Agent
attributes.description: Answers questions about deliveries that went wrong.

attributes.name: Web Application
attributes.description: Serves the single-page application to a browser.

attributes.name: Single-Page Application
attributes.description: Books deliveries and shows the progress of a parcel.

attributes.name: Courier App
attributes.description: Scans parcels at pickup, handover and delivery.

attributes.name: Event Broker
attributes.description: Carries scan events so ingest and notification are not one step.

attributes.name: Delivery Database
attributes.description: Stores deliveries, parcels and every scan against them.

attributes.name: Routing Optimiser
attributes.description: Works out the cheapest route for a set of parcels.

attributes.name: Mapping Provider
attributes.description: Turns addresses into coordinates and draws maps.
Delivers to the web browser of the customer
